title: Pure Gadget
summary: Pure Gadget monsters with generic Rank 4s, Links, and staples. Every Gadget is a Level 4 EARTH or LIGHT Machine that replaces itself on summon or destruction, feeding an endless loop of Rank 4 Xyz plays.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gold Gadget and Silver Gadget Special Summon a Level 4 Machine from the hand when Normal or Special Summoned, and float into a Level 4 Gadget from the Deck when destroyed by battle or card effect.
Green Gadget, Red Gadget, and Yellow Gadget form a three-part search circle: Green searches Red, Red searches Yellow, and Yellow searches Green on any Normal or Special Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Gold or Silver Gadget + Colour Gadget
steps: Normal Summon Gold Gadget (or Silver Gadget) and use its effect to Special Summon Green, Red, or Yellow Gadget from the hand.
Trigger the colour Gadget to search the next colour Gadget in the cycle from the Deck, refilling your hand.
Overlay both Level 4 Machines into Gear Gigant X, and detach 1 material to search another Gold Gadget, Silver Gadget, or Cyberse Gadget for next turn.
With a second pair of Level 4 Machines, make a second Rank 4 Xyz and overlay both Xyz Monsters into Number F0: Utopic Future and Number F0: Utopic Draco Future.

summary.title: Machine Extenders & Support
points: Platinum Gadget, made with any 2 Machine monsters, Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Machine from the hand to a zone it points to and summons a Level 4 Gadget from the Deck when destroyed (note: it cannot be used as Link Material the turn it is Link Summoned).
Cyberse Gadget revives a Level 2 or lower monster from the GY on Normal Summon and spawns a Level 2 Gadget Token when sent from the field to the GY.
Ancient Gear Gadget declares a card type on summon to prevent the opponent from activating it when your monster attacks, and can copy the name of Green, Red, or Yellow Gadget.

Stronghold the Moving Fortress Special Summons itself as a Level 4 Machine Trap Monster and gains 3000 ATK while you control Green, Red, and Yellow Gadget; Boot-Up Soldier - Dread Dynamo jumps to 2000 ATK while you control any Gadget.

summary.title: Extra Deck Payoff
points: Gear Gigant X detaches a material once per turn to add any Level 4 or lower Machine from your Deck or GY to your hand, keeping the Gadget engine stocked every turn.

Number F0: Utopic Draco Future cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, and detaches a material once per turn to negate an opponent's monster effect and take control of that monster if it is on the field.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Gadget Trio only searches Shining Sarcophagus cards and belongs in the Shining Sarcophagus and Gandora builds. Gadget Gamer and Gadget Box support Morphtronic Synchro plays and lock the Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters, so they are excluded here.

allow.Gear Gigant X: Generic Machine Rank 4 that searches a Gadget; tagged Geargia only because of its second effect.
allow.Number F0: Utopic Draco Future: Rank 0 boss monster providing once-per-turn monster effect negation and monster snatching.

exclude.Gadget Trio: Searches only Shining Sarcophagus cards; it is on the Shining Sarcophagus list.
exclude.Gadget Box: Morphtronic card that limits the Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters.
